principle: Every safe CJ variant may be selected unless verified unavailable. Cart may carry PRICE_PENDING, but payment/supplier handoff requires fresh Commerce Truth PASS.

stages.expects: Live provider product + variant feed loads; stale fallback is visibly non-buyable.
CJ variants remain selectable while stock is unknown; only verified unavailable variants are blocked.
Quantity +/−, remove and clear have a native navigation fallback independent of runtime handlers.
Selected CJ variant gets a fresh stock check before cart readiness.
Actual shipping is included in Commerce Truth; retail adjusts upward only when needed to preserve approved contribution/margin.
A verified route, method, origin and destination shipping amount exist.
Fresh authenticated payment session has Commerce Truth PASS and current evidence.
Dry-run passes before any CJ sandbox execution; live payment/supplier remain gated.

invariants: Never fabricate price, stock, shipping, product or variant availability.
PRICE_PENDING may enter cart; it may not enter payment or supplier execution.
Destination price adjustment is disclosed before payment and re-evaluated through the same Profit Gate.
Live payment and live supplier execution stay Owner-Gated.
